descriptions.zh: DBS接入您在阿里云购买的云数据库（如RDS、MongoDB、 Redis、PolarDB）或阿里云ECS上自建的数据库时， 需通过服务关联角色（AliyunServiceRoleForDBS）获取访问权限。更多信息，请参见[开通数据库备份DBS服务](~~162603~~)。
descriptions.en: DBS uses the service-linked role (AliyunServiceRoleForDBS) to obtain the required access permissions to connect to ApsaraDB databases, such as RDS, MongoDB, Redis, and PolarDB, or self-managed databases on ECS instances. For more information, see [Activate the Database Backup service](~~162603~~).
